• In this tap away puzzle game, your goal is to clear the grid—a maze of arrows all pointing in different directions.

• Escape the arrow puzzle grid by finding a free path. An arrow moves only when its way ahead is clear and no other arrows are blocking its path. Take a moment to think first.

• Tap arrows away one by one to help them leave the grid and open up more space for the others.

• Avoid blocked arrows. If you tap an arrow whose path is blocked, you lose a life. Lives are limited on each level, but you can always rethink your plan and try again at your own pace.

• If you get stuck, use helpful hints to highlight an arrow that can safely escape the maze.

• Plan the order of your taps, help every arrow escape, and enjoy the moment when the last arrow leaves and everything falls into place.

Distance Meter is a complete measurement toolkit with AR distance measuring and 9 professional tools — all in one app. Powered by Google ARCore, the app detects your device\'s hardware and selects the best measurement engine for maximum accuracy.

Whether you\'re leveling a shelf, measuring room dimensions, or checking angles, Distance Meter has the right tool for every job.

[9 Measurement Tools]

Distance Meter goes far beyond a simple ruler. It includes 9 specialized tools:

• Bubble Level — Circular spirit level with realistic 3D liquid and bubble animation. Check if surfaces are perfectly horizontal.

• Clinometer — Slope and angle gauge measuring 0° to 90°. Ideal for roofs, ramps, and terrain slopes.

• Plumb Bob — Digital plumb bob with gravity-based pendulum. Verify perfect vertical alignment.

• Protractor — Touch and sensor-based angle measurement from 0° to 180°. Measure angles between objects or surfaces.

• Screen Ruler — On-screen ruler in centimeters and inches. Measure small objects directly on your phone screen.

• Frame Checker — Camera-based frame alignment tool. Check if picture frames, TVs, and shelves are perfectly level.

• Height Meter — AR-powered height measurement. Measure the height of people, furniture, doors, and buildings.

• Width & Height — AR dimension measurement. Get both width and height of objects in a single session.

• Area Calculator — AR multi-point area calculation. Mark corners to calculate floor area, wall space, or any surface.

[Smart Measurement Engine — 4-Tier System]

Your device is automatically matched to the best available engine:

• Premium (ToF/LiDAR) — Hardware depth sensors deliver ±2cm accuracy. Ideal for construction and precise work.

• High (Depth API) — Software depth estimation with ±5cm precision. Available on most modern devices.

• Standard (ARCore) — Surface detection and feature tracking with ±10cm accuracy.

• Basic (Camera) — Camera-based estimation for devices without AR support.

[How to Measure]

1. Tap the Measure button or select a tool

2. Point your camera at the target

3. Wait for the green indicator (optimal conditions)

4. Align the crosshair and tap to measure

5. Results display instantly with estimated accuracy (±cm)

[Real-Time Accuracy Feedback]

Distance Meter monitors 5 conditions in real time:

• Tracking status — Is ARCore actively tracking?

• Lighting — Is the scene well-lit?

• Surface detection — Has a surface been found?

• Feature points — Are enough visual features visible?

• Camera stability — Is the device steady?

[Multi-Strategy Fusion Technology]

This AR ruler combines results from multiple measurement strategies (Depth, Plane, Point Cloud) using confidence-weighted fusion, eliminating outliers and improving accuracy by up to 30%.

[Key Features]

• 9 measurement tools in one app

• 4-tier AR engine (ToF/LiDAR → Depth API → ARCore → Basic)

• 6 units: meters, centimeters, feet, inches, yards, millimeters

• Auto-save measurements to history

• Sound and vibration feedback

• Grid overlay and level indicators

• Dark and light mode support

• Status bar shortcut for quick access

[Tips for Best Results]

• Ensure good lighting (avoid very dark or very bright conditions)

• Move your device slowly during initialization

• Keep a steady hand — stability directly affects accuracy

• Measure textured surfaces (avoid mirrors, glass, solid white walls)

• Optimal AR range: 0.5m to 5m
